negative_control: The same scheduled minutes at constant open=close100, high100.1, low99.9 have no unique pivots, gaps, directional impulses or qualifying setup. This control does not replace family-specific boundary cases.
minute_path: For multi-minute candles, synthesize O→H→L→C at minute0, floor(n/3), floor(2n/3), n-1; repeated intermediate minute closes stay at the last value. Every minute has volume10000. A one-minute candle uses the specified OHLC directly.
execution_window: Starts on the hand-specified candidate's session and ends two later setup candles after it. Earlier bars warm detectors; positive signal time/level and resulting trade identity must match, and execution must agree with the independent Decimal reference.
